description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for a device, including image verification, partition handling, and image writing commands.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the partition layout of an image against the current device, ensuring compatibility before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the target partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the device upgrade process, including handling partition differences and writing images to device partitions.
